note: Standard chess-piece SVG set (cburnett) for the shared chess kit remotion/src/lib/chess.tsx, which renders pieces via staticFile('library/chess/<code>.svg'). Upstream shipped without this directory (BASELINE-REPORT.md PF-1: Short1Chess crashed on every render). White pieces (w*) use #f8f8f8 fill, black (b*) #101010, both with black outlines — designed to read on the kit's board colors. See LICENSE.txt for the GPL/BSD-3/GFDL tri-license provenance.
